result.summary: The page is generally well composed; the partial carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior. One minor contrast issue stands out.

issues.description: The profile/avatar button at the top right is a near-white circle on a white background, so its boundary is barely perceptible and it is hard to recognize as a tappable control; only the small red notification dot provides a clear visual cue.
issues.suggestion: Give the avatar a stronger border, subtle shadow, or a visible placeholder icon so the button is distinguishable from the background.
